metadata.domain: High-Nickel Cathode Materials / Secondary Battery Materials

evidence.trl_pathway: All three technologies start at TRL 6-7 and require only incremental advancement within 2-3 year windows, which is highly realistic for mature material/process domains; no aggressive TRL jumps are present.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio is domain-appropriate and commercialization-focused, but all three technologies complete 0.75-1.0 years AFTER their boom windows, which is suboptimal for 시장이익최대 — a profit-maximization strategy demands tighter timing alignment, not post-boom delivery.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All selected technologies are squarely within the High-Nickel Cathode / secondary battery materials domain, showing strong domain fit; the inclusion of silicon composite anode materials is a natural adjacency that complements cathode leadership.
evidence.market_timing: Under 시장이익최대, completion should fall within ±0.5 years of the boom, but all three technologies miss their respective boom windows by 0.75-1.0 years, consistently landing after peak market opportunity rather than at its apex.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selection of high-nickel cathode and precursor technologies aligns with areas of known patent intensity and market growth, but the roadmap provides no explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting; the silicon anode inclusion appears market-driven without clear patent-side justification.

strengths: All technologies are firmly within the company's core domain, ensuring competitive advantage and execution credibility
TRL progression is entirely realistic — starting from TRL 6-7 minimizes development risk and supports commercialization focus
weaknesses: Systematic post-boom completion across all three technologies undermines the profit-maximization strategy by missing peak market pricing windows
The portfolio is narrow (only 3 technologies) and lacks diversification; a single development delay could significantly damage the entire roadmap's commercial impact
missing_technologies: 건식 전극 공정 기술 (Dry electrode process) — high market growth and patent activity in cathode manufacturing
단결정 양극재 코팅 기술 — complements multi-crystalline cathode work and addresses cycle stability markets
investment_issues: Budget is fully exhausted with zero slack, leaving no contingency for development delays or cost overruns on the TRL 6 silicon anode technology which carries higher uncertainty (score 3)
Strategic tier assigned to T01 is justified, but the 2-year development window starting 2026-Q1 may be insufficient to reach full commercial readiness before the 2027-Q2 boom
timing_issues: 고니켈 양극재 다결정화 기술 completes 2028-Q1 but boom is 2027-Q2, missing peak by ~0.75 years — should target 2027-Q2 completion
양극재 전구체 합성 최적화 completes 2030-Q1 vs 2029-Q1 boom — a full year late, missing the market peak entirely
고성능 음극재 completes 2030-Q1 vs 2029-Q2 boom — 0.75 years post-peak reduces ROI potential
